79647.subject: 🧬 Claude made medical history
79647.body:

Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Claude found a new way to edit genes in virus DNA. ChatGPT Voice updates get us closer to Tony Stark’s Jarvis. And btw… it drove a real car through a parking lot. Bernie Sanders' AI ban is now an actual bill.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Anthropic:** What did 950 Claude agents find in just 21 hours?

* **OpenAI:** Can you really talk your work into existence?

* **DrivingBench:** How do you get ChatGPT to drive a car?

* **Sanders:** What changed now that the bill is real?


----------







----------
## Claude found a new gene editor

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/1f34c3f7-cade-409e-b385-31a3472f7f58/Sep_24.-_1.jpg?t=1790242294)
Caption: 

Anthropic [put about 950 Claude agents on a giant database of DNA](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-discovers-novel-enzyme-system) and told them to hunt for one type of enzyme. They ran for 21 hours with nobody touching them.

One agent, reading raw DNA next to an odd-looking gene, noticed a pattern nobody had catalogued. A short sequence repeating over and over, with a unique gap between each copy. That's the shape CRISPR has.

It tried to prove itself wrong by searching the literature, then filed a report. Anthropic's scientists tested it in the lab and named it ART.

* It lives in viruses that infect bacteria

* Nobody knows what it does yet

* Dario Amodei says it could be a new way to edit genes, and repeated his line that AI could cure most diseases within 10 years

* Feng Zhang, one of the pioneers of CRISPR, reviewed it and called it worth investigating

This is the first result from the Bay Area lab we told you about on Monday. It's a preprint on Anthropic's own site, not a peer-reviewed paper.

Anthropic reran the same experiment ten more times. The agents missed it every time.


----------







----------
## You don’t need to be an expert, you can just prompt it

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/0af70d2c-7ba7-422b-ac07-e972dfa54eb2/hakathon.png?t=1789031505)
Caption:

* Free to enter, open to anyone 16 or older, anywhere.

79645.subject: Affirm’s new AI underwriting model works best on borrowers with no FICO score 🤖💸; No iCoin, no Google USD. Apple…
79645.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1130

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Thursday! Today, we’re breaking down Affirm's new AI underwriting model to see why its biggest gains come from applicants with no FICO score (how the transformer actually plugs into Affirm's XGBoost stack, why Affirm's own repayment data drove most of the gains, what the second-look test did & didn't measure, & what to watch next + bonus deep dives into Affirm’s latest financials [ https://substack.com/redirect/328068df-3968-4276-bd9c-8d5cf22fa698?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], Revolut's PRAGMA [ https://substack.com/redirect/4fc2f0ff-a0cf-4d88-b2db-be55921b564c?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and How to Build an Agentic OS with Claude Fable 5 [ https://substack.com/redirect/34ce117b-1cd5-4017-bcba-743d5ee39b1d?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and diving into Apple and Google's hunt for stablecoin talent to see why neither company is building an iCoin or a Google Dollar (why both job listings ask for tokenized deposits, why Apple is hiring a payments strategist while Google hires a Web3 architect in Hong Kong, how Nubank already built the model Apple is likely studying, & the signals to watch next + bonus deep dive into How Google Is Building the Interface Between AI & Money [ https://substack.com/redirect/233d6666-80fe-4e61-b7d6-c263d8b4bfe0?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and The Ultimate List of Stables Resources [ https://substack.com/redirect/66dc3c20-b993-4921-a1b9-2d954f0db91c?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s just jump straight into the finnovative stuff 🌶️
Affirm’s new AI underwriting model works best on borrowers with no FICO score 🤖💸
The news 🗞️ Affirm’s $AFRM  new AI underwriting model, a transformer now live at U.S. checkout, gets its largest gains on applicants with no FICO score, using credit report data Affirm already had. Affirm’s own engineering blog shows that the headline result, 3.4% more completed purchases, came from a narrower test than the press release implies.
Let’s take a closer look at this to see how the model fits into Affirm’s credit stack, where its edge comes from, which numbers hold up, and the experiment that will show whether other lenders should copy the approach...

79632.subject: 🟪 NEAR's second act
79632.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/9f199753-ca31-4e3d-9435-5e12896ecff5/BD_NL_Banner_Heading.png?t=1781793903)
Caption: 

# Don’t fade NEAR

When price and fundamentals move together, that catches my eye.

NEAR has nearly doubled in a week and is now up 178% since mid-August, helped by confidential perps and a Zcash fueled swap business. The rally looks sudden, but the business underneath it has been changing for much longer.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/c3e31175-6422-4700-b56e-055c3e3c6636/image.png?t=1790181818)
Caption: 

Underneath the re-rating, REV has regained momentum but under a different business model. Since January 2025, execution fees fell 83%, from $120K a week to $20K. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/a9997eee-396a-4654-bcbd-339aa4c7623d/image.png?t=1790181817)
Caption: 

However, every dollar of that loss was replaced by NEAR Intents (a transaction type that lets users perform actions across different blockchains without manually managing execution routes or gas fees). Before the fee switch activation in February 2026, NEAR routed Intents volume and captured none of it. Intents now constitute ~85% of NEAR REV and NEAR is up 350% since the activation.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/1173d2d5-b373-49a8-af8a-6bdc76f0d86f/image.png?t=1790181817)
Caption: 

This focus on Intents came at the cost of native activity. Relayer-paid (delegated) transactions were 78% of NEAR's volume in Q1 2026 and had been the bulk of it since 2024. These were gas-subsidized consumer apps, and the subsidy stopped.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/3c0a6721-37d0-482a-b20b-c3e67512af0d/image.png?t=1790181818)
Caption: 

The effect can be seen in the fee data. Token burn has fallen from 100K NEAR in January 2025 to 20k NEAR in August 2026. The monthly burn rate now sits at 0.7%, though with an all-time high of 3.4% in March 2024, the burn was insignificant anyway. 

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/0b802ece-7f90-4b08-944f-e187b5632c0c/image.png?t=1790181817)
Caption: 

The activity mix for NEAR Intents is mainly deposits, withdrawals and swaps.

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/80ff0ecc-01bc-4d95-8cbb-14040ce7a45f/image.png?t=1790181818)
Caption: 

But swaps are where the money is made and SwapKit, a cross-chain swap SDK embedded in wallets like Ledger Live, BitPay and Tr
